entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: Mightiest human warrior of Jund on Alara, wielder of Mage Slayer, with 22 braids.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Kresh lives.

entities.name: Highclan Tol Hera
entities.description: Clan whose warriors rescued Kresh as an infant.

entities.name: Javid Hera
entities.description: Leader of Kresh's clan who splintered it into the Tol Antaga.

entities.name: Tol Antaga
entities.description: Clan splintered off by Javid Hera, to which Kresh belonged.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker whose agent controlled Kresh's clan.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: Bolas's agent who manipulated Kresh and his clan.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who left Kresh and his clan to die after a fight with dragons.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who convinced Kresh to fight back.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event when the shards of Alara came together.

events.summary: Kresh was rescued from a burning village by Highclan Tol Hera warriors as an infant.
events.quote: he was rescued from a burning village by warriors of Highclan Tol Hera as an infant

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol and Rakka left Kresh and his clan to die after a fight with dragons.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol and Rakka left Kresh and his clan to die after a fight with dragons

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane convinced Kresh to fight back.
events.quote: Ajani Goldmane showed up and convinced Kresh to fight back.

events.summary: When the shards came together, Kresh led Jund's faction against Bolas' forces.
events.quote: Kresh led the faction from Jund that fought Bolas' forces.

relations.quote: Kresh led the faction from Jund that fought Bolas' forces.
